build_regnet_model: build a RegNet model from a config dict using build_model with depth, w_0, w_a, w_m, and group_width parameters
test_regnet_model_forward: test a RegNet model forward pass by passing a random tensor and verifying output shape matches batch size
quantize_regnet_model: quantize a RegNet model stem using FX graph mode quantization with prepare_fx and convert_fx APIs
test_regnet_activation_swap: test swapping ReLU activations to SiLU in a RegNet model and verify the models match via repr comparison
test_regnet_preset_models: test building RegNet preset models like regnet_y_400mf or regnet_x_8gf using just the name in the config
